summary: ansible.builtin.items is the Jinja builtin filter returning an iterator over a mapping's (key, value) pairs.
questions: How do I iterate over key/value pairs of a dict in Jinja?

answer_card.title: items filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ mydict | items }}` returns an iterator over the mapping's `(key, value)` pairs (Jinja builtin).
